evidence.headline: Preview 7 build and package checks
evidence.framing: These are compilation and package-integrity checks. They do not establish visible playback, audible calls or daily-driver reliability.
items: Windows desktop and capture host built in release mode.
Android ARM64 and x86-64 native libraries rebuilt; APK assembly and lint completed.
Package versions, Android signature, APK structure and updater manifest checked.
Installer, APK and portable bundle have published SHA-256 checksums.
caveats: Interactive Board, profile-picture, audio and screen-sharing acceptance remains open.
Separate-network direct/relay sessions and extended physical-device use remain unverified for these packages.
Earlier LAN measurements are historical and are not measurements of preview 7.

capability_groups.title: Sending and watching
capability_groups.intro: Included screen-sharing features, with device requirements and testing results.

items.name: Screen and window capture
items.detail: Share an entire screen, or pick a single window, from a Windows x64 PC.

items.name: Video quality controls
items.detail: Choose 60 or 30 fps and adjust stream quality while a session is running. Those controls do not promise sustained 60 fps on every PC.

items.name: H.264 encoding
items.detail: Windows shares H.264 using the available encoder. Hardware support and CPU cost vary; this build has not been validated on every vendor.

items.name: Android receiving
items.detail: Android 8 or newer receives screens using its decoder. This release includes ARM64 and x86-64 native libraries; physical playback remains unverified for these packages.

items.name: Windows receiving
items.detail: A second Windows PC can receive the screen and system audio. Both ends need matching builds.

items.name: Computer audio
items.detail: The sending PC can include system audio with its screen. Audible output and endurance remain unverified for this build.

capability_groups.title: Features awaiting physical validation
capability_groups.intro: These features are included, but physical-device tests remain outstanding.

items.name: Private session admission
items.detail: The viewing device issues a private invitation that authorises the session over a pinned QUIC connection. Expiry, replay, and revocation pass loopback tests; physical regression testing is still open.

items.name: Two-way microphone voice
items.detail: One-to-one and group calls use direct peer paths with relay fallback. Physical microphone, echo and network-handoff checks remain outstanding.

items.name: Remote control from Android
items.detail: Android receives screens. It does not currently provide the account proof required by named-account remote-control grants, so those sessions remain view-only.

items.name: Cursor appearance and effects
items.detail: Desktop cursor styling with a local effects budget. The current build labels this preview only.

items.name: Several viewers on one share
items.detail: One Windows capture can serve up to eight independently admitted viewers. Windows Tables subscribe to up to four live friend screens and support late joins. Physical multi-device acceptance remains open.

items.name: Sharing a screen during a call
items.detail: A call and a screen share can run together. Accepted Windows friends discover live Table shares automatically after the sender explicitly starts sharing.

items.name: Windows Table layout and fullscreen
items.detail: Seats resize from every edge and corner. Settings are menus; fullscreen hides the surrounding UI. Interactive acceptance remains open.

items.name: Profile pictures
items.detail: Windows and Android support choosing, changing and removing profile pictures. Android uses explicit Save and Discard controls.

items.name: In-call text and files
items.detail: Windows and Android include session chat and consent-based file transfer. Files require a direct route; session chat is not a durable offline archive.

items.name: Automatic update checks
items.detail: These matched downloads include the update manifest used by the Windows and Android preview update channel. Installer/update lifecycle validation remains open.

capability_groups.title: Features with additional limitations
capability_groups.intro: Internet playback remains unqualified, and accounts and contacts have local-storage limitations.

items.name: Viewing outside your local network
items.detail: Direct routes are preferred and the existing FastCast VPS provides relay fallback. This build includes negotiation and route-repair fixes, but unrelated-network physical acceptance remains open.

items.name: Device-owned accounts and contacts
items.detail: Device-held keys identify accounts. The coordination service supports profiles, friends and invitations; it is not a fully decentralized account service.

capability_groups.title: Not in this download
capability_groups.intro: The following features are not included in {{RELEASE_LABEL}}.

items.name: Linux desktop
items.detail: The application source includes a Linux viewer using OpenH264 with optional VA-API, but no Linux package is published here. Sending a screen from Linux is unavailable.

items.name: macOS, iPhone, and iPad
items.detail: Not implemented. This preview download is Windows x64 and Android 8 or newer only. Android does not send.

limitations: Windows binaries are unsigned; Android is debug-signed. Use matching versions.
Physical UI, audio, screen-sharing and unrelated-network acceptance remains open for these packages.
Direct connections minimize VPS media traffic; relay fallback still uses VPS bandwidth.
Bulk file transfers require a direct route and explicit acceptance; they do not use VPS fallback.
Networks blocking all UDP have no call/media fallback. Persistent room discussions use the coordination service.
Automatic Table viewing is view-only. Named-account remote control currently requires a compatible Windows viewer.
Android receives screens and supports calls/chat; Android screen broadcasting is not implemented.
No owner/process migration or durable offline peer chat is provided.
macOS, iPhone, iPad and browser apps are not available; Linux is not in this download.

history.label: 0.3.2 Preview 7
history.summary: Combines the latest Table resizing, icons and fullscreen fixes with Android/Windows profile pictures, group route repair and loopback connection fixes. Matching Windows installer, Android APK, portable bundle and updater manifest. Physical acceptance remains open.

history.label: 0.3.2 Preview 5
history.summary: Multi-viewer screen sharing, and screen sharing during a call. Preview 5 makes sharing during a call work both ways and stops a call and a share from ever sending the microphone twice.

history.label: 0.3.2 Preview 4
history.summary: Multi-viewer screen sharing: one share now serves up to eight viewers from a single encode, each admitted with its own pinned invitation. A call and a screen share can run together, with the call keeping the microphone. Neither has been exercised across two machines.

history.label: 0.3.2 Preview 3
history.summary: Calls now start: friend requests, signalled voice over the FastCast relay, self-hosted STUN, and relay media fan-out. Screen sharing is still one sharer to one viewer, and unrelated-network calls remain unmeasured.

history.label: 0.3.2 Preview 2
history.summary: UX sheets, host-first Go live watch-place, rustls call-listen fix. Android still viewer-only for capture. Matching Win+Android preview packages.

history.label: 0.3.2 Preview 1
history.summary: Matching Windows and Android builds. One physical Windows-to-Android LAN run on the published files.

history.label: 0.3.1 Preview 1
history.summary: Earlier matching Windows and Android packages. Package integrity was checked; physical playback was not established by those publication checks.
